examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhāvan'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñ'c'āpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti, ettakaṃ vata me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ hiyyo, ettakaṃ pare'ti, atha khv'assa khīṇe khīṇan'tv'eva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā, vipassakā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, pubbaratt'āpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharissāmā'ti.

49802.meaning1: devoted to meditation practice; engaged in mental cultivation

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.
indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā, vipassakā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, pubbaratt'āpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharissāmā'ti.

49803.meaning1: making effort to develop; striving to cultivate

examples.text: cattāri padhānāni. saṃvarapadhānaṃ pahānapadhānaṃ bhāvanāpadhānaṃ anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ.
upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. idaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhāvanāpadhānaṃ.

49804.meaning1: maturity by development; completion by cultivation; full development by meditation

examples.text: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. vīriyindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

49805.meaning1: making effort to develop; striving to cultivate

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhāvanāppadhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ… dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgaṃ… vīriyasambojjh'aṅgaṃ… pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ… passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ… samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ… upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.

navame kilesānaṃ saṃvar'atthāya pavesanadvāraṃ pidahan'atthāya padhānaṃ saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pajahan'atthāya padhānaṃ pahānappadhānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ brūhan'atthāya vaḍḍhan'atthāya padhānaṃ bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, tesaṃ'y'eva anurakkhaṇ'atthāya padhānaṃ anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ.

49806.meaning1: strength of meditation; power of mental development

examples.text: veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā, n'atthi me pubben'āparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanābalan'ti.

49807.meaning1: developed by meditation; accomplished by meditation; experiential
49807.commentary: (ITIa) jarāmaraṇaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassantassa yā cetanā, yā ca pathavīkasiṇ'ādīsu aṭṭhatiṃsāya ārammaṇesu pavattā jhānacetanā, yā ca anavajjesu kamm'āyatana-sipp'āyatana-vijjā-ṭṭhānesu paricayamanasikār'ādi-vasena pavattā cetanā, sabbā bhāveti etāyā'ti bhāvanāmayaṃ vuttanayena puññakiriyavatthu cā'ti.

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ n'ābhisambhoti. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā manussasobhagyaṃ upapajjati.
kusalā cetanā kām'āvacarā rūp'āvacarā dānamayā sīlamayā bhāvanāmayā, ayaṃ vuccati puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.

49808.meaning1: delighting in meditation; loving mental cultivation
49808.commentary: (DNa) vuttanayen'eva bhāvanāya ārāmo assā'ti bhāvan'ārāmo. bhāvanāya rato'ti bhāvanārato.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

49809.meaning1: delight in meditation; love for mental cultivation

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

49810.meaning1: enjoying meditation; taking pleasure in mental cultivation
49810.commentary: (DNa) vuttanayen'eva bhāvanāya ārāmo assā'ti bhāvan'ārāmo. bhāvanāya rato'ti bhāvanārato.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

49811.meaning1: fact of enjoying meditation; fact of taking pleasure in mental cultivation
49811.commentary: (VISMa) bhāvanā āramitabb'aṭṭhena ārāmo etassā'ti bhāvan'ārāmo, tabbhāvo bhāvan'ārāmatā, samathavipassanābhāvanāsu yuttappayuttatā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

49814.meaning1: claim about meditation; declaration about spiritual development

examples.text: bhāvanāvādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, bhāvitakāyo'mhi bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati

49816.meaning1: (gram) statement in abstract formation using -tta or -tā suffix

examples.text: kāsattam'iti bhāvaniddesena aññatth'āpi s'āgamo hoti. ahosi, adāsi.
atha kho pañcak'aṅgassa thapatissa etadahosi, akālo kho tāva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, paṭisallīno bhagavā. manobhāvaniyānam'pi bhikkhūnaṃ asamayo dassanāya, paṭisallīnā manobhāvaniyā bhikkhū.

ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
aniccadassāvī kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.
tath'eva tvam'pi ahitahite, samaṃ mettāya bhāvaya, mettāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti.

49821.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd sg of bhāvayati, caus, trans (+acc)
49821.meaning1: one oneself cultivates; one oneself develops

examples.text: vitakk'ūpasame ca yo rato, asubhaṃ bhāvayate sadā sato, esa kho byanti kāhiti, esa checchati mārabandhanaṃ.
sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañ'ca bhāvayaṃ, ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, so imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭaṃ.
so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti. tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti anusayā byantīhonti.
ete dhamme bhāvayitvā, tayo sukhasamuddaye, abyāpajjhaṃ sukhaṃ lokaṃ, paṇḍito upapajjatī'ti.
pañca chinde pañca jahe, pañca c'uttari bhāvaye, pañca saṅg'ātigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇo'ti vuccati.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

49826.meaning2: (gram) formula of establishment by state (e.g. socanan'ti soko)

examples.text: abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ'ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho'smi brāhmaṇa.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā sati no bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.

49828.meaning1: (comm) Jain doctrinal term for the pleasure of the five senses

49829.meaning1: who has developed the basis for success

examples.text: kathaṃ bhagavā bhāvit'atto? bhagavā bhāvitakāyo bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño bhāvitasatipaṭṭhāno bhāvitasammappadhāno bhāvita-iddhipādo bhāvita-indriyo bhāvitabalo bhāvitabojjhaṅgo bhāvitamaggo, pahīnakileso paṭividdhākuppo sacchikatanirodho.
kāyabhāvanam'pi kho tvaṃ, aggivessana, na aññāsi, kuto pana tvaṃ cittabhāvanaṃ jānissasi? api ca, aggivessana, yathā abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca, bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto ca.
bhāvanāvādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, bhāvitakāyo'mhi bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.
bhāvanāvādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, bhāvitakāyo'mhi bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati
kāyabhāvanam'pi kho tvaṃ, aggivessana, na aññāsi, kuto pana tvaṃ cittabhāvanaṃ jānissasi? api ca, aggivessana, yathā abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca, bhāvitakāyo ca hoti bhāvitacitto ca.

49834.meaning1: who is awakened; who has a developed mind; who is self-developed; evolved person
49834.commentary: (SNa) bhāvit'atto'ti attānaṃ bhāvetvā vaḍḍhetvā ṭhito. (DHPa) ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānan'ti yo pana ekaṃ sīl'ādiguṇavisesena vaḍḍhita-attānaṃ heṭṭhimakoṭiyā sotāpannaṃ, uparimakoṭiyā khīṇ'āsavaṃ gharadvāraṃ sampattaṃ kaṭacchubhikkhādānavasena vā yāpanamatta-āhāradāna-vasena vā thūlasāṭakadānamattena vā pūjeyya.
49834.notes: MW: one whose soul is purified by meditating on the universal soul, whose thoughts are fixed on the Supreme Spirit, meditative, devout, holy, a sage, saint.

examples.text: māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.
pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ, maññāmi taṃ vedaguṃ bhāvit'attaṃ, kuto nu dukkhā samudāgatā ime, ye keci lokasmim'anekarūpā.

49835.notes: MW: one whose soul is purified by meditating on the universal soul, whose thoughts are fixed on the Supreme Spirit, meditative, devout, holy, a sage, saint.

examples.text: ariyassa bhāvit'attassa, pattipattassa veyyākaraṇassa, satimato vipassissa, anabhinatassa no apanatassa, anejassa vasippattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

49837.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.

49838.meaning1: fact of being cultivated; state of being developed (of)

examples.text: imesañ'ca pan'āhaṃ, āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāmi dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cā'ti
tassa kho esā, aggivessana, uppannā'pi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannā'pi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati bhāvitattā cittassa.

49839.meaning1: developed in wisdom; cultivated in understanding; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: bhāvanāvādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, bhāvitakāyo'mhi bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.

49840.meaning1: developed in behaviour; cultivated in ethical conduct

examples.text: bhāvanāvādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, bhāvitakāyo'mhi bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.
evaṃ sante kho, uttara, andho bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati, badhiro bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati yathā pārāsiviyassa brāhmaṇassa vacanaṃ
ariyo hoti bhāvit'indriyo, sace ākaṅkhati, paṭikūlañ'ca appaṭikūlañ'ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno'ti, upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.

49843.grammar: prp of bhāviyati, caus, pass, intrans

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, kālā sammā bhāviyamānā sammā anuparivattiyamānā anupubbena āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpenti

49844.meaning1: going to be; fated; inevitable; predestined

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
cakkhu aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. rūpā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. itth'etaṃ dvayaṃ calañ'c'eva byathañ'ca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.

49845.grammar: pr, pass of bhāveti, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: vipassanā, bhikkhave, bhāvitā kam'attham'anubhoti? paññā bhāvīyati. paññā bhāvitā kam'attham'anubhoti? yā avijjā sā pahīyati.

49846.meaning1: should be cultivated; should be developed

examples.text: yā c'āvuso, paññā yañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, imesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ no visaṃsaṭṭhānaṃ paññā bhāvetabbā, viññāṇaṃ pariññeyyaṃ. idaṃ nesaṃ nānākaraṇan'ti.
abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ'ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho'smi brāhmaṇa.
kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ vippahāya, sukkaṃ bhāvetha paṇḍito, okā anokam'āgamma, viveke yattha dūramaṃ.
kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. sakkā, bhikkhave, kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no ce'daṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvethā'ti.

49850.meaning1: wanting to develop; wishing to cultivate

examples.text: karuṇaṃ bhāvetu'kāmena pana nikkaruṇatāya ādīnavaṃ karuṇāya ca ānisaṃsaṃ paccavekkhitvā karuṇābhāvanā ārabhitabbā.

49851.meaning1: to cultivate; to develop; to grow; to increase
49851.meaning2: to increase, to cultivate, to develop

examples.text: kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. sakkā, bhikkhave, kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no ce'daṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvethā'ti.
karuṇaṃ bhāvetu'kāmena pana nikkaruṇatāya ādīnavaṃ karuṇāya ca ānisaṃsaṃ paccavekkhitvā karuṇābhāvanā ārabhitabbā.

49852.meaning2: having increased, having cultivated, having developed

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.

49855.commentary: (THa) bhāvento satipaṭṭhāne'ti maggapariyāpanne kāyānupassanādike cattāro satipaṭṭhāne uppādento vaḍḍhento ca. (THIa) bhāventī maggam'añjasan'ti majjhimapaṭipattibhāvato añjasaṃ uparimaggaṃ uppādentī.

examples.text: bhāvento satipaṭṭhāne, indriyāni balāni ca, bojjh'aṅgāni ca bhāvento, viharissāmi kānane.
sikkhamānā ahaṃ santī, bhāventī maggam'añjasaṃ, pahāsiṃ rāgadosañ'ca, tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave.
satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ.

49858.meaning1: will shine; will illuminate; will brighten

examples.text: ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.

49859.meaning1: you will shine; you will illuminate
49859.commentary: (SNPa) bhāhisī'ti bhāsissasi pakāsessasi. imaṃ paṭipadaṃ bhāvento sabbadisāsu kittiyā pākaṭo bhavissasī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.

49860.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhako, labhanto vā alabhanto vā ariyāya yācanāya yācatī'ti attho.

examples.text: na tena bhikkhako hoti, yāvatā bhikkhate pare, vissaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya, bhikkhu hoti na tāvatā.

bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu, samaññāya bhikkhu, paṭiññāya bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhū'ti bhikkhu, tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampanno'ti bhikkhu
asso'va jiṇṇo nibbhogo, khādanā apanīyati, bālakānaṃ pitā thero, par'āgāresu bhikkhati.
abhutvā bhikkhasi bhikkhu, na hi bhutvāna bhikkhasi, bhutvāna bhikkhu bhikkhassu, mā taṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.
pattaṃ daṇḍañ'ca gaṇhitvā, bhikkhamānā kulā kulaṃ, sīt'uṇhena ca ḍayhantī, satta vassāni cāri'haṃ.
ahaṃ raṭṭhāni vicaranto, nigame rājadhāniyo, bhikkhamāno mahārāja, ācariyassa dhan'atthiko.

49866.grammar: imp, reflx 2nd sg of bhikkhatu, irreg form of bhikkhassu, intrans (+loc)

examples.text: muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

49867.grammar: imp, reflx 2nd sg of bhikkhatu, intrans
49867.meaning1: you yourself must beg for alms

examples.text: abhutvā bhikkhasi bhikkhu, na hi bhutvāna bhikkhasi, bhutvāna bhikkhu bhikkhassu, mā taṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.
tasmā't'iha bhikkhave attadīpā viharatha
satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.
tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu, cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsu, sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā, indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā'ti.
avihaṃ upapannāse, vimuttā satta bhikkhavo, rāgadosaparikkhīṇā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
tato malā malataraṃ, avijjā paramaṃ malaṃ, etaṃ malaṃ pahantvāna, nimmalā hotha bhikkhavo.
araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.
anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.

te upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.
ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ niccaṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti
dhammikā'ti kuhan'ādi-bhedaṃ micchājīvaṃ vajjetvā dhammena samena bhikkhācariyavattena uppannā.

49874.meaning1: wandering for alms; roaming for food
49874.commentary: (VINa) piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ nissāya pabbajjāya ussāhajātattā vā bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu.

examples.text: anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.

bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu, samaññāya bhikkhu, paṭiññāya bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhū'ti bhikkhu, tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampanno'ti bhikkhu

49875.meaning1: wandering for alms; roaming for food

examples.text: paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.

49877.meaning1: common road for wandering for alms

examples.text: kāmesu n'ābhigijjheyya, manas'ānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti.

49887.meaning1: principle of non-decline for a monk

49888.meaning1: advising the monks; instructing the mendicants
49888.commentary: (ANa) bhikkhu-ovādakānan'ti bhikkhū ovadantānaṃ mahākappinatthero aggo'ti dasseti. ayaṃ kira thero ekasamodhānasmiṃ'y'eva dhammakathaṃ kathento bhikkhusahassaṃ arahattaṃ pāpesi. tasmā bhikkhu-ovādakānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhu-ovādakānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākappino.

49889.meaning1: group of monks; crowd of mendicants

examples.text: so ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe vikatthati, bhuttāvī c'amhi yāva'd'attho, nimantito c'amhi svātanāya, piṇḍapāto ca my'āyaṃ pūro, lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ

49890.meaning1: counting the monks; calculating the number of monks
49890.meaning2: counting the monks; calculating the number of monks
49890.commentary: (KVa) bhikkhugaṇanā'ti ettakā bhikkhū uposath'agge sannipatitā'ti bhikkhūnaṃ gaṇanā. idam'pi hi ubhayaṃ katvā'va uposatho kātabbo.

examples.text: utu'kkhānañ'ca, bhikkhugaṇanā'ca, bhikkhunīnam'ovādo cā'ti.
ovādo, bhikkhuṇīnaṃ ovādo dātabbo dinno kiṃ?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: kiṃ pattinam'āhu bhikkhunaṃ, sorataṃ kena kathañ'ca dantam'āhu. buddho'ti kathaṃ pavuccati, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ'y'eva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca karaṇīyaṃ.
cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?

49894.meaning1: rule about making nuns give massages

49895.meaning1: organized by a nun; arranged by a nun
49895.meaningLit: brought to fruition by a nun
49895.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhuniparipācitan'ti bhikkhuniyā paripācitaṃ, guṇappakāsanena nipphāditaṃ, laddhabbaṃ katan'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhuniparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā, pācittiyaṃ.

49896.meaning1: group of nuns; assembly of female monastics

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti. tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena'pi sā attamanā hoti.

49897.meaning1: community of nuns; female monastic order

examples.text: upāsakā bhikkhunisaṅghassa cīvar'atthāya chandakaṃ saṃharitvā, aññatarassa pāvārikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā, bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
atha kho mahāpajāpatigotamī pañcamattehi bhikkhunisatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati rājak'ārāme. atha kho sahasso bhikkhunisaṃgho yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
